title: AuditStateResult
description: Result of `deadlatch audit init`. CLI JSON stdout must match this document on both success and failure. Never includes absolute paths, credentials, account data, or raw state/log contents.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this result document.

status.description: initialized = first durable state published; unchanged = existing valid state already covers the collection; error = refused.

reserved_through.description: Watermark after a successful init, or null on error.

error_code.description: Stable identifier on error; null on initialized/unchanged.
